hold_text: Tier-2 and it must not self-land. Two reasons, and the second is the one that decides it. (1) SURFACE: it changes src/runtime/telegram_decisions.py and adds src/runtime/decision_channel_alert.py — src/runtime/** is Tier-2 by CLAUDE.md's table, and the MI-303 dispatch says so in terms. (2) ARMING: taking effect needs an `ict-telegram-bot.service` RESTART on the live VM, which is a VM mutation and needs one operator OK in chat. The approval sought is therefore a merge click plus that restart, from the operator. ⚠️ WHAT THE CHANGE DOES AND DOES NOT TOUCH, so the read is cheap: it is the operator COMMS path only — no order path, no strategy config, no risk caps, no account mode, and nothing reads or writes trade_journal.db. The behaviour change to confirm is that a decision prompt whose body exceeds Telegram's 4096-character cap is now SHORTENED — question and every option label/implication kept, `context` dropped — with the body stating that it was shortened and naming the object YAML, instead of failing to send at all. On the live corpus that is 5 of 33 requests shortened and 28 unchanged. The alternative to shortening is the status quo, which is silence: 0 of 5 over-cap requests have ever been delivered.
why: Tier-2 by surface AND by arming. src/runtime/telegram_decisions.py is modified and src/runtime/decision_channel_alert.py is added, and src/runtime/** is Tier-2 per CLAUDE.md § Permission tiers; on top of that the fix only takes effect after an ict-telegram-bot.service restart, which is itself a Tier-2 VM mutation needing an operator OK. The diff is the operator COMMS path only — no order path, no strategy params, no risk caps, no account-mode flip, no DB write — so the blast radius is bounded to whether decision prompts are delivered, which is currently zero. It fixes BL-20260917-THE-WORK-DECISION-SWEEP-REPORTS-ITSELF-HEALTHY-AND-ROUTED-WHILE-FAILING-TO-SEND-EVERY-CANDIDATE-ON-47-OF-47-RUNS (severity critical): Telegram caps sendMessage's text at 4096 characters, the render had no budget anywhere, and 4 operator decisions were structurally undeliverable while every health field on the sweep receipt read good. I am not merging it myself and no auto-merge request file is on this branch.
